title: VeriQuote: deterministic and semantic verification of quote-grounded LLM citations
description: VeriQuote verifies citations in source-grounded LLM answers. The answering model must attach a verbatim quote to every cited claim (EVI1 protocol); VeriQuote then (1) locates the quote in the source with a deterministic fuzzy matcher (character-trigram Dice similarity over normalized sliding windows, with exact and typography-normalized fast paths) and (2) classifies the claim–quote entailment strength with a temperature-0 LLM judge. Results are combined conservatively into per-citation and per-answer transparency scores, giving end users direct insight into which statements are supported and which are confabulated. Zero-dependency TypeScript; runs in Node, browsers, and edge runtimes. Reference deployment: NavigNine.
